grid.title: Acompanhamento de Metas de Vendas Mensais
grid.expression: SELECT M.APELIDO AS GRUPO, NVL(V.VENDAS, 0) AS VENDAS, NVL(D.DEVOLUCOES, 0) AS DEVOLUCOES, M.VLRMET AS META, -- Saldo agora subtrai as devoluções antes de abater a meta (NVL(V.VENDAS, 0) - NVL(D.DEVOLUCOES, 0) - M.VLRMET) AS SALDO, CASE WHEN (NVL(V.VENDAS, 0) - NVL(D.DEVOLUCOES, 0) - M.VLRMET) >= 0 THEN '#b4f7b4ff' ELSE '#f38484' END AS BKCOLOR FROM AD_TGSSGM M LEFT JOIN ( -- Subquery VENDAS (Exatamente como estava) SELECT COMP.CODSGRU, SUM(I.QTDNEG) AS VENDAS FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO P ON I.CODPROD = P.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU G ON P.CODGRUPOPROD = G.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN AD_TGSISGM COMP ON ( (COMP.TIPO = 'G' AND G.CODGRUPOPROD = COMP.CODGRUPOPROD) OR (COMP.TIPO = 'P' AND G.CODGRUPAI = COMP.CODGRUPOPROD) ) WHERE C.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202) AND C.TIPMOV = 'V' AND P.USOPROD = 'V' AND TRUNC(C.DTNEG, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(C.DTNEG, 'YYYY') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND COMP.ANO = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) AND COMP.MES = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM') GROUP BY COMP.CODSGRU ) V ON M.CODSGRU = V.CODSGRU LEFT JOIN ( -- NOVA Subquery DEVOLUÇÕES SELECT COMP.CODSGRU, SUM(I.QTDNEG) AS DEVOLUCOES FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFITE I ON C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO P ON I.CODPROD = P.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU G ON P.CODGRUPOPROD = G.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN AD_TGSISGM COMP ON ( (COMP.TIPO = 'G' AND G.CODGRUPOPROD = COMP.CODGRUPOPROD) OR (COMP.TIPO = 'P' AND G.CODGRUPAI = COMP.CODGRUPOPROD) ) WHERE C.CODTIPOPER IN (1200,1201,1206,1216,1217,1272) AND C.TIPMOV = 'D' AND P.USOPROD = 'V' AND (C.CODEMP = 501 OR NVL(C.STATUSNFE, 'X') <> 'D') -- Regra inserida aqui AND TRUNC(C.DTNEG, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(C.DTNEG, 'YYYY') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND COMP.ANO = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) AND COMP.MES = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM') GROUP BY COMP.CODSGRU ) D ON M.CODSGRU = D.CODSGRU -- Filtra a meta para o ano e mês corrente WHERE M.ANO = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) AND M.MES = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MM') ORDER BY M.APELIDO
